name: sandbox
description: Run Python code in an isolated Docker container (no network, no access to your files, 60 s, 256 MB) and show the output: 'run this in the sandbox: ```print(sum(range(10)))```'. Input is the Python code itself. Good for calculations, tables, statistics and parsing text.
route: run this python, run this code in the sandbox, execute this script safely, test this code
